parts.text: Our checkout-service has been throwing payment timeouts and failed transactions.
Got it -- checkout-service seeing payment timeouts and failed transactions. When did this start?

property.description: the response does not re-ask for the affected service or the symptoms -- both were already given earlier in this conversation (checkout-service; payment timeouts and failed transactions).

the response either offers a confirmation summary of the incident (since service, symptoms, and start time are all now known) or asks only for something genuinely still missing (e.g. a title) -- it does not ask an open-ended "tell me more" question.
